=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_detect_merge_conflicts.sh:319-331 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The criss-cross merge conflict heuristic loop ignores git probe errors by only breaking on rc=1.
  WHY: A transient git merge-tree failure is recorded in _criss_cross_probe_rc but the loop continues and logs "No merge conflicts detected" and exits 0, so a genuinely conflicted PR is not auto-resolved (source severity MAJOR; other reviewers (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash) called this documented fail-open design, not a regression).
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:288 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fork-PR filter relies on `env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY` being readable inside gh's `--jq` filter, which has no in-repo precedent, and the new test passes only because it runs real `jq`.
  WHY: If gh's filter rejects `env`, the listing fails on every page and the step opens a new fallback PR each release, reintroducing the duplicate-PR behavior (source severity NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
